name: Vector Art
description: Flat saturated shapes, a heavy contour, and no shading.
bestFor: Marketing sections that should read as crisp vector artwork.
promptFragment: Visual style: Vector Art. Use flat fills, bold black contours, simple geometric shapes, and a few saturated colors. Corners are smoothly rounded. Avoid gradients, blur, texture, photoreal shading, and thin gray chrome. Keep text readable: meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (4.5:1) against the surface the text actually sits on. https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html
